//----- Regenerated by session tooling from the final patched project.json -----------------------------------------

WhenBroadcastReceived(forever)
{
  If ((Not((leftdoorstate == 'closed')) And (Contains(camlist['1'], 'man') Or (Contains(camlist['1'], 'women1') Or Contains(camlist['1'], 'women2')))))
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume8);
    Sound.Play(fnaf-2-ambience-sound-effect);
    Event.Broadcast('phone warning');
  }
  Else
  {
    If ((Not((rightdoorstate == 'closed')) And (Contains(camlist['2'], 'man') Or (Contains(camlist['2'], 'women1') Or Contains(camlist['2'], 'women2')))))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume9);
      Sound.Play(fnaf-2-ambience-sound-effect);
      Event.Broadcast('phone warning');
    }
  }
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Looks.Show();
  reset = '0';
  counter = '0';
  Costume.GoToFrontBack(back);
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
  Motion.GoToXY('0', '0');
  Forever
  {
    Motion.SetX(((Motion.XPosition() - ((Sensing.MouseX() + Motion.XPosition()) / '30')) / '1.16'));
    Event.Broadcast('forever');
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(right light)
{
  If ((rightlightstate == 'on'))
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume3);
    Control.Wait('2');
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
    Control.CreateCloneOf(Light);
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(left light)
{
  If ((leftlightstate == 'on'))
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume2);
    Control.Wait('2');
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(right door)
{
  If ((rightdoorstate == 'closed'))
  {
    If ((counter == '1'))
    {
      Stop(this script);
    }
    Else
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume6);
      Control.Wait('0.05');
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume7);
      counter = '1';
      If ((((Costume.GetNumberName(number) == '7') And (counter == '1')) And (leftdoorstate == 'closed')))
      {
        Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume12);
        Control.Wait('0.05');
        Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume13);
      }
      Else
      {
        Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume12);
        Control.Wait('0.05');
        Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume7);
      }
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume6);
    Control.Wait('0.05');
    If ((leftdoorstate == 'closed'))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume12);
      Control.Wait('0.05');
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume5);
    }
    Else
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
    }
    counter = '0';
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(left door)
{
  If ((leftdoorstate == 'closed'))
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume4);
    Control.Wait('0.05');
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume5);
    If ((rightdoorstate == 'closed'))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume12);
      Control.Wait('0.05');
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume13);
    }
    Else
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume12);
      Control.Wait('0.05');
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume5);
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume4);
    Control.Wait('0.05');
    If ((rightdoorstate == 'closed'))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume12);
      Control.Wait('0.05');
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume7);
    }
    Else
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
    }
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(hide)
{
  Looks.Hide();
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(show)
{
  Looks.Show();
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Repeat Until ((time == '6 AM'))
  {
    Control.Wait('60');
    If ((Length(time) == '5'))
    {
      time = Join((Join(Letter('1', time), Letter('2', time)) + '1'), ' AM');
    }
    Else
    {
      time = Join((Letter('1', time) + '1'), ' AM');
    }
    If ((time == '13 AM'))
    {
      time = '1 AM';
    }
  }
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Repeat Until ((power == '0%'))
  {
    Control.Wait('6');
    If (((rightdoorstate == 'closed') Or (leftdoorstate == 'closed')))
    {
      If ((Length(power) == '2'))
      {
        power = Join((Letter('1', power) - '1'), '%');
      }
      Else
      {
        If ((Length(power) == '3'))
        {
          power = Join((Join(Letter('1', power), Letter('2', power)) - '1'), '%');
        }
        Else
        {
          power = Join((Join(Join(Letter('1', power), Letter('2', power)), Letter('3', power)) - '1'), '%');
        }
      }
      If (Not((power == '0%')))
      {
        Control.Wait('5');
        If ((Length(power) == '2'))
        {
          power = Join((Letter('1', power) - '1'), '%');
        }
        Else
        {
          If ((Length(power) == '3'))
          {
            power = Join((Join(Letter('1', power), Letter('2', power)) - '1'), '%');
          }
          Else
          {
            power = Join((Join(Join(Letter('1', power), Letter('2', power)), Letter('3', power)) - '1'), '%');
          }
        }
      }
    }
    Else
    {
      If ((Length(power) == '2'))
      {
        power = Join((Letter('1', power) - '1'), '%');
      }
      Else
      {
        If ((Length(power) == '3'))
        {
          power = Join((Join(Letter('1', power), Letter('2', power)) - '1'), '%');
        }
        Else
        {
          power = Join((Join(Join(Letter('1', power), Letter('2', power)), Letter('3', power)) - '1'), '%');
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Forever
  {
    If ((power == '0%'))
    {
      Event.Broadcast('death');
      Stop(all);
    }
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(death)
{
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(costume1);
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(forever)
{
  If (((Sensing.Timer() > '10') And ((Costume.GetNumberName(number) == '8') Or (Costume.GetNumberName(number) == '9'))))
  {
    Event.Broadcast('death');
    reset = '2';
    Stop(all);
  }
  If ((((reset == '0') And (Sensing.Timer() > '10')) And Not((reset == '2'))))
  {
    reset = '1';
    Event.Broadcast('reset pos');
    Stop(this script);
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(forever)
{
  Forever
  {
    If (((Costume.GetNumberName(number) == '8') Or (Costume.GetNumberName(number) == '9')))
    {
      Event.Broadcast('reset');
      Stop(this script);
    }
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(reset)
{
  Wait Until ((reset == '0'));
  Sensing.ResetTimer();
  reset += '1';
}
